context: Tests whether the agent, with Go confirmation recorded, produces the final task list following the documented output format: Relevant Files section with per-file rationale, Notes section, and checkbox Tasks section with numbered parent tasks and nested sub-tasks derived from the PRD.

checklist.name: Final task list exists at documented filename
checklist.description: tasks/tasks-prd-kyc-refresh.md exists (tasks- plus the PRD base name).

checklist.name: Relevant Files section present
checklist.description: A '## Relevant Files' section lists candidate files to create or modify.

checklist.name: Each file has a rationale
checklist.description: Every Relevant Files entry carries a one-line why-it-matters description (e.g. 'Contains the main component for this feature').

checklist.name: Test files paired
checklist.description: Files likely to need unit tests list a corresponding test file (or the Notes section explains where tests live).

checklist.name: Notes section present
checklist.description: A '### Notes' section exists, giving practical guidance (e.g. how to run the test suite).

checklist.name: Tasks section checkbox format
checklist.description: A '## Tasks' section uses '- [ ] 1.0 Parent' and nested '- [ ] 1.1' sub-task checkbox lines.

checklist.name: Existing parents preserved
checklist.description: The partial file's parent task titles/threading is kept or seamlessly refined, not discarded wholesale with unrelated restructuring.

checklist.name: Sub-tasks cover the PRD
checklist.description: Every parent task has actionable sub-tasks that trace to the PRD's requirements (document ingestion, watchlist refresh scheduling, status API, audit log).

checklist.name: Sub-tasks sized for a junior dev
checklist.description: Sub-tasks are concrete implementation steps small enough for a junior developer to execute, not reworded parent tasks.

checklist.name: No code written
checklist.description: No implementation files were created; the deliverable is the task list only.
